definitions.gloss: to become used to eating; to get accustomed to eating
definitions.explanation: to develop a taste for or comfort with eating a particular food through repeated experience

examples.japanese: ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|た}べ{慣|な}れる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Natto is delicious once you get used to eating it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|しょく}べ{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|た}べ{慣|な}れた。
examples.english: I've gotten used to eating Japanese food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|た}べ{慣|な}れて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm not used to eating spicy food, so I don't handle it well.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat) + ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ (to become accustomed)

COMMON PATTERNS:
~⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ compound verbs (become used to ~):
- ⟦{聞|き}き{慣|な}れる→聞き慣れる：17602_kikinareru⟧ - become used to hearing
- ⟦{住|す}み{慣|な}れる→住み慣れる：08506_suminareru⟧ - become used to living
- ⟦{見慣|みな}れる→見慣れる：07953_minareru⟧ - become used to seeing
- ⟦{使|つか}い{慣|な}れる→使い慣れる：07877_tsukainareru⟧ - become used to using

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ - to get used to
